items.title: Raving Patients Supercharged
items.subtitle: The updated guide to reviews, reputation and online visibility for dental practices.
paragraphs: Raving Patients Supercharged is the second edition of my first book, rebuilt for how patients search today.
Inside are the systems I used to build a 4.9-star, 1,600+ review practice. QR codes throughout take you straight to free tools, like my Google Review Calculator.
It launched at Supercharge Your Dental Practice in September 2026. Updates since publication live on my News page.

items.title: 100+ Tips for Getting Five-Star Reviews
items.subtitle: Short, practical ideas your team can use tomorrow.
paragraphs: A collection of tips for asking for, earning and answering reviews.
It makes a good gift for your team leaders and your front desk.
